subject: LumenPay trial: qualification recap and implementation checkpoints
messages:
From: Anna Voss <anna@lumenpay.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: LumenPay trial next steps and integration questions

Hi Rishi and Marissa,

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying questions so we can scope a short trial. High level the use case is transaction classification and risk tagging for 6M monthly transactions (sampling first 30 days). We want to evaluate accuracy, latency under sample load, and the SDK streaming experience for live routing to downstream services.

Key open questions for your team:
- Recommended model variant for cost/latency balance for 25 token average outputs
- Streaming vs batch tradeoffs and what the SDK supports out of the box
- Tokenization and sample size guidance for the first 30 days of trial
- Data retention and logs for compliance (SOC2) during trial

We have an internal engineer who will own the integration: Devon Park (devon@lumenpay.io). Please loop him in on the tech details.

Attachments: POC-MAP.xlsx (we included a rough milestone grid and data sample pointers).

Would love a one page success criteria and ownership table we can sign off on. Can we do a 30 minute kickoff this week?

Cheers,
Anna Voss
Head of Payments Engineering
LumenPay

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Anna Voss <anna@lumenpay.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 17:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: LumenPay trial next steps and integration questions

Thanks Anna, great to meet you. Recap below and a proposed minimal trial plan so we can get to qualitative results quickly.

Quick recap of commitments from our side
- We will provide a scoped 3-week trial that exercises both streaming and a small batch endpoint.
- We propose Redwood model variant: rdx-2b-q8 (good balance of throughput and token cost for 25-token outputs). We can fallback to rdx-1b for strict latency SLOs.
- We will enable prefix caching and a 30-minute KV cache window tuned to your traffic pattern during the trial.
- We will surface token-level latency and cost breakdowns per route in the Console dashboard for the trial.

Proposed success criteria (suggested, please confirm)
1) Precision on high-risk tags >= 92% on a 1k labeled sample
2) 95th percentile inference latency < 280ms for streaming requests under a 50rps sample load
3) End-to-end streaming reliability >= 99.5% for trial period
4) SDK integration completed with a sample ingestion route and live routing to downstream service (ack test)

Trial evaluation plan and timelines
- Week 0 (kickoff, align success criteria, exchange test data)
- Week 1 (baseline runs, model variant A vs B, instrumentation)
- Week 2 (streaming resilience tests, A/B on quantization if needed)
- Week 3 (quality-focused evaluation, final acceptance)

Ownership table (short)
- Redwood PM/Eng owner: Rishi Malhotra (trial owner, instrumentation, SLOs)
- Redwood Solutions Eng: Marissa Cole (integration support, SDK handoff)
- Customer eng owner: Devon Park (data, app routing, acceptance)

Technical ask from your team
- Share a sanitized sample with representative events (5k record CSV or JSONL) and the attached POC-MAP filled with preferred dates.
- Confirm whether the downstream ack endpoint will accept a server-to-server webhook or if you prefer function-calls from the SDK.

I attached a compact POC-MAP to this note. If that looks good I will create a short kickoff invite for Wednesday or Thursday.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Anna Voss <anna@lumenpay.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon@lumenpay.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: LumenPay trial next steps and integration questions

Thanks Rishi, that looks very reasonable. A couple clarifications from Devon and me:

- Data format: we will send a JSONL with fields transaction_id, amount_cents, payer_id, payee_id, metadata (string) and a label field for the 1k gold set. We will attach a sample data_schema.json and a small 500-row sample to the shared drive.
- Ack flow: we prefer server-to-server webhook for production parity, but for the initial trial we can accept SDK function calling to an internal lambda if that simplifies instrumentation.
- Streaming: Devon wants to confirm that the Redwood SDK keeps a persistent HTTP/2 stream and supports message-level ACKs. He also asked about reconnect behavior under intermittent connectivity.

Devon has agreed to own the engineering work on our side. Devon, can you confirm available times for a 30 minute tech kickoff tomorrow?

Attachment: data_schema.json (small sample schema).

Anna

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Aug 2028 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: LumenPay trial owners and kickoff scheduling

Marissa / Neha,

Looping you in after the tech clarifications from Anna. Actions I propose so we move fast:

- Marissa: own the SDK onboarding and the live tool-calling example. We should have a short repo with a Node and Python example that shows function calling to a lambda and server-to-server webhook routing. Target deliverable: example repo and two demo routes by Aug 6.
- Neha: own instrumentation and Console permissions for the account. Please pre-provision a trial org, enable token-level logs, and set retention to 30 days for the trial.
- Rishi (me): run baseline runs and tune rdx-2b-q8 kernels. I will prepare a lightweight eval harness and the 1k labeled sample test plan.

Kickoff availability: I proposed Wed Aug 2 11:00 AM PT to Anna and Devon as a 30 minute slot. If that does not work I put tentative Thursday 9:00 AM PT.
